gen-dafont-joystix-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri has a tall, rounded, friendly body. Over a long passage it feels gentle and unhurried, while Joystix keeps its widely spaced arcade swagger up top.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-khula: Bold arcade attitude comes from Joystix, wide-spaced and chunky. It does the shouting well, and Khula, a plain sans with a tall belly and open curves, does the quiet, steady talking.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-krub: Widely tracked, pixel-chunky lettering is what defines Joystix. Krub then takes over with a pronounced x-height and curves that never quite close, giving the page a lighter, breezier footing.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-kufam: Joystix spaces its bold arcade letters far apart, with a subtle thick-and-thin rhythm across each line. Kufam follows with a smooth, tube-like line that moves along easily.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-lexend: Joystix is the arcade shout, bold and widely spaced, with only a faint hint of thick and thin. Lexend, a plain sans with outsized lowercase, handles the talking.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca draws a wire-thin, unshaded line with big lowercase and small capitals. Its strongest quality is that quiet clarity, which lets Joystix be the loud arcade one.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-mada: Joystix brings wide-tracked arcade boldness, with bowls that thin only gently. Mada, in sans-serif form, rises with a towering midzone and curves left open, giving the page a friendlier floor.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-matangi: Matangi has a hefty lowercase and rounded letters left open, like twine pressed flat. Its strongest quality is that sturdy texture, which holds its own against the arcade stomp of Joystix.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-maven-pro: Widely tracked arcade lettering defines Joystix, with stems barely heavier than their arms. Maven Pro stays out of its way, a smooth monotone line with a high waist and open c.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-michroma: Joystix spreads its bold arcade letters wide, with stems barely heavier than their arms. Michroma, a sans-serif with generous side room and tall bodies, reads in a stately, spaced-out way across paragraphs.
